ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to show luggage storage points near you.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: We use the camera to scan the guest's booking QR code and to photograph the condition of bags at drop-off.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: We use Face ID to unlock the app lock.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: We add your booking's drop-off and pick-up times to your calendar.
